rationale_evidence.statement: Structural reading: AIP's current implemented core is a workflow/authority engine plus guard surfaces -- not a product domain. The product it serves (the election/voting platform, the KnowledgeOS body of knowledge) is outside AIP; AIP governs the process of building it, not the product itself.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Every invariant BC-7 (the workflow engine) owns is mechanically enforced; almost every invariant outside BC-7 is declared only
rationale_evidence.statement: Headline structural finding -- the invariant asymmetry: assurance is strong where it is executable (BC-7) and weak where it is prose (outside BC-7). 'The platform mechanically protects orchestration, and protects knowledge/verification/communication only by declaration.' Stated as the single most important structural property of AIP's current architecture.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Knowledge-concern vs platform-concern -- candidate split (evidence/finding, NOT decided)
rationale_evidence.statement: Candidate split (not decided): Knowledge concern (BC-1 NOT BUILT; Knowledge Engineer adopted-role-only); Assurance concern (BC-3/BC-4, partial/missing); Platform/mechanical concern (BC-7, workflow engine, registry -- fully implemented, A); Communication concern (C-10 NOT ESTABLISHED, C-19 stewardship, Communication Engineer nervous-system framing in unadopted history -- F/G). OQ-D (the EKP/PKS boundary) is explicitly OPEN -- deliberately not decided.

Seven headline findings: (1) AIP is a registry-first, session-based engineering operating platform, not a product domain; (2) the implemented core is the workflow/authority engine plus guard surfaces, with knowledge/review components deferred/not built and verification under construction; (3) the invariant asymmetry is the load-bearing structural property; (4) the authority record lives in an ignored runtime directory (the durability inversion), decided-but-not-executed; (5) the D1/D2 decision state is contradictory across the corpus, surfaced not reconciled; (6) four unowned capabilities form one control loop with C-10/C-14 existence UNDECIDED; (7) AIP self-records four capability failures (EKS-01..04) -- the platform observing its own uneven assurance.
